So, I buy them food that is is a mix of dried veggies and pellets. They only get fed once a day, because they don't need more than that. They usually get fed around 6-7 PM my time, and they know when dinner time is, because they'll start squeaking and purring when I get up to feed them.

But man, they are snobby.

And I say that with all the love in my heart.

Because this is what they will do.

All the dried veggies and yummy parts are gone. Just the pellets left. And then if I get up, they'll go back to the food dish and squeak like it's dinner time again, because they just want more dried veggies and yummy bits. Luckily, usually by the next dinner time, all the food is gone from the dish.
Fun fact: My guinea pigs are snobby when it comes to their food.
